topic.title: Types of Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks.

body.p: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks support different review scenarios. Use the following information to understand how they differ.

row.entry: Not tied to a project. They can be created from or from supported desktop tools.
Only users with the Author role can create them.
Users with the Author role and users with the Subject-Matter Expert role can create them.
All users with the Author role who have access to the project can see all review tasks created in that project.
Only the task owners and the reviewers who are granted access to the task can see and access it.
Accepted changes can be integrated back into the project content as part of the project review task workflow.
Any follow-up integration is handled outside the review task workflow.
Use this type when the content is already managed in a project.
Use this type when the content is outside a project or when you start the review from a supported desktop tool.

section.title: Project Review Tasks
section.p: Project Review Tasks are part of the project workflow. At the end of the review process, task owners can integrate the review task changes into the project.

section.title: Independent Review Tasks
section.p: Independent Review Tasks are useful when the reviewed content is not managed in a project.

To create independent review tasks from desktop tools, install the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector add-on. It integrates into Oxygen XML Editor and Oxygen XML Author. For more information, see the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector Add-on Documentation.
